infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Forever Stories needs access to your camera to capture photos and videos for your stories.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Forever Stories needs access to your photo library to attach photos and videos to your stories.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Forever Stories needs microphone access to record videos with audio.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Forever Stories uses your contacts to help you invite family and friends. Selected contact names, emails, or phone numbers will be sent to our server to deliver invitations.

plugins.photosPermission: Forever Stories needs access to your photos to attach them to your stories.
plugins.cameraPermission: Forever Stories needs access to your camera to take photos for your stories.
